# ACE-FCA + Incremental Numbering System

The `.github/ace-fca/` directories use numeric prefixes (`0001-topic-c.md`, `0002-topic-a.md`) instead of date-based naming to improve IDE navigation and search clarity. This system allows users to quickly locate and reference the chronological output from research, planning, and retrospective prompts without date ambiguity. The numeric sequence creates clear relationships between related documents across the ACE-FCA workflow phases.

- There is no completion in the VS Code chat and typing an ISO 8601 date is not fun
- The File Explorer window must be uncomfortably wide to see the entire name.
- Using a date ordering causes confusion because a completed ACE-FCA cycle might span many days _and_ you might do more than one in a day.
